author: Ariadne I
title: Adaptive Dual-Decay v2: Contextual Mixture m[b,k] + 2nd-Order Copy Head
abstract: Builds on Adaptive Dual-Decay by making the fast/slow mixture m context-adaptive (m[b,k]) from the 4-step input factors and enhancing the residual copy head with a 2nd-order finite-difference term. Retains per-factor temporal gating S[b,t,k], curvature regularization, and gradient clipping. Rank k=128.
